export_evidence: ImportKey company page for FLODEAL exists (https://importkey.com/countries/india/flodeal) but renders only the shell: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world" — zero shipment rows visible (0 rows seen, counter gated behind paywall). No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was retrievable. Volza (403), Eximpedia (403), ImportGenius (JS challenge), Trademo (403) all blocked. Only company self-declaration found: flodeal.com homepage — "20+ Years Manufacturing & export experience / 30+ Countries / 500+ Containers" and About page — "Flodeal proudly serves customers across six continents... North America – United States and Canada; Europe – United Kingdom, Germany, France...". These are marketing claims with no shipment record attached.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found in any accessible source. Zaubacorp lookup returned HTTP 403, so no legal-entity/GST data could be read. Site lists four Indian locations ("Udaipur - Mysore - Ongole - Khammam") and claims "In-House Factories" in North and South India, but this is a catalogue/website statement, not supply evidence.
note: Следов поставок не найдено в открытых источниках: ни одной экспортной записи с датой, направлением, HS-кодом и номером B/L получить не удалось — все четыре торговых базы данных (ImportKey, Volza, Eximpedia, ImportGenius, Trademo) закрыты платно или блокируют доступ.
